rows.name: Direction
rows.mission: Decide what Orizn sells, to whom and on what terms. The root of the org chart and the approver of record: this seat wears no role pack and takes no turns.
rows.head: founder
rows.title: CEO / founder

rows.name: Commercial
rows.mission: Find a verifiable entry-requirement defect in a prospect's own booking flow, reproduce it, and hand the qualified account to a human. No prices, no terms, no signatures.
rows.head: sdr
rows.title: Sales Development

rows.name: Clients
rows.mission: Answer the carriers, platforms and travel teams that write in, reproduce what they report against our own data, and escalate anything touching money, credentials or deletion.
rows.head: support
rows.title: Customer Success

rows.name: Growth
rows.mission: Study how buyers search for entry-requirement data, read what competitors publish about coverage, and hand drafts to a colleague. Nothing this seat writes reaches the public.
rows.head: acquisition
rows.title: Head of Growth

rows.name: Finance
rows.mission: Keep the books, reconcile the accounts, prepare approved supplier invoices for payment and prepare the filings. Every payment goes to a person before it moves.
rows.head: books
rows.title: Finance
